Low driving and 1 fps Night Vision time-lapse parking were additionally confirmed by a Windows card scan; do not confuse the Low driving quality with Low Bitrate continuous parking or 30 fps playback with capture cadence.

High/AED card scan: four Movie MP4 files, three retained video samples. Medium/Low Bitrate card scan: three Movie MP4 files, two retained video samples. These are separate card inventories, not counts to add. Folder-based driving mapping is manual context, not native recognition.
High/AED scan: one parking MP4 sample. Medium/Low Bitrate scan: four parking MP4 files, three retained samples. Parking behavior follows the owner-confirmed setting, not the folder or bitrate alone.
One protected parking MP4 file observed. RO alone is not proof of an impact-triggered rather than motion-triggered event.

technical_facts.label: Firmware 1.2_20260817 owner parking power tests
technical_facts.value: At owner-confirmed actual 12.4 V supply with HK6-F cable: Auto Event Detection monitoring 252 mA / 3.12 W; Auto Event Detection recording 252 mA / 3.12 W; continuous Low Bitrate parking 256 mA / 3.17 W.
